name: Riso fluorescent pink and medium blue
description: The classic two-drum risograph pairing: fluorescent pink and medium blue on warm cream paper. Where the inks cross they multiply into a deep violet. Loud, playful and arty; reads as printed, not digital. Good for events, studios, exhibitions, zines, nightlife with a craft feel.

ground.use: the paper: the whole background, left bare around the type

accent.use: the headline and one big flat shape

second.use: the image zone: shapes, stamps or the photo's shadows

rules: two inks only: accent and second (ink is the same blue)

name: Riso orange and green
description: Bright orange with a deep fresh green on cream: the colours of fruit and leaves. Warm, generous and edible. Good for food, markets, cooking, gardens, community events and anything about sharing.

accent.use: the headline and the big shape

second.use: the image zone, leaves, stems, the photo

rules: orange is the voice, green the support

name: Riso bright red and teal
description: Bright red over teal on off-white. Sharper and more urgent than pink and blue; still clearly print. Good for talks, protests, sales with character, music, sport, anything that should feel energetic but crafted.

accent.use: the headline and the big shape

rules: red is the voice, teal the support

name: Riso violet and sunflower
description: Violet type over a sunflower-yellow image zone on cream. Bright and optimistic with good contrast for type (the yellow never carries text). Good for spring and summer events, kids, festivals, flowers, music in the park.

accent.use: the headline and the big shape

second.use: the image zone only: never text, too light on cream

rules: violet over yellow multiplies into brown: keep the crossing small

name: Swiss bone, black and signal red
description: Warm bone paper, near-black type, one signal-red shape. The international typographic style at its plainest: serious, confident, cultural. Good for design events, lectures, museums, architecture, typography, brands that want authority.

accent.use: one big shape only, never text

rules: red appears once, as a shape

name: Swiss white, black and electric blue
description: Clean white, black type and one electric-blue shape. Cooler and more technical than bone and red. Good for tech, science, product launches, conferences, fintech, anything precise and modern.
rules: blue appears once, as a shape

name: Night: black, warm white and yellow
description: A near-black ground with warm-white type and one yellow shape: the inverted, nightlife version of the swiss palettes. Dramatic and high contrast. Good for clubs, concerts, film nights, late openings, launches after dark.

accent.use: one big shape; may carry the headline in riso-style templates

second.use: hairlines and the image zone's tint

rules: the dark is the design: keep it mostly empty

name: Forest, cream and tangerine
description: Deep forest-green type on cream with a tangerine shape and a sage support. Earthy, calm and premium. Good for wellness, coffee, organic food, outdoor brands, slow living, bookshops.

accent.use: one big shape, or the headline in riso-style templates

second.use: the image zone and quiet details

rules: tangerine is a highlight, not a background
